name: Toast
import: import { Toaster, Toast, ToastAction, ToastClose, ToastContent, ToastDescription, ToastPortal, ToastProvider, ToastTitle, ToastViewport } from "@/components/ui/toast"

ToastProvider.name: timeout
ToastProvider.description:
The default amount of time (in ms) before a toast is auto dismissed.
A value of `0` will prevent the toast from being dismissed automatically.

ToastProvider.name: limit
ToastProvider.description:
The maximum number of toasts that can be displayed at once.
When the limit is exceeded, the oldest toasts are marked as `limited` (via the `data-limited`
attribute) rather than removed, so they can be hidden or animated out.

ToastProvider.name: toastManager
ToastProvider.description: A global manager for toasts to use outside of a React component.

ToastPortal.name: container
ToastPortal.description: A parent element to render the portal element into.

ToastPortal.name: className
ToastPortal.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

ToastPortal.name: render
ToastPortal.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

ToastPortal.name: style
ToastPortal.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.
